howto.what: 装上后，当你想实现代码变更时，Claude会以Developer角色工作：先判断是否需测试驱动（是则转/tdd），否则直接读代码、遵循现有模式、做最小改动、运行验证检查（如lint、测试），最后总结变更并建议下一步操作。
howto.when: 当你请求实现代码变更（如说“实现这个功能”）或直接输入`/code`时触发。Claude会切换为Developer persona处理。

say.text: 请实现这个功能，遵循现有项目模式。
为我写一段代码，并运行验证检查。
say.note: Claude会实现最小改动并运行lint、测试等。

say.text: 实现这个变更，不需要编写测试。
say.note: Claude会跳过测试驱动，直接实现。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude acts as Developer: decides if test-first (routes to /tdd), otherwise reads code, follows patterns, makes minimal changes, runs verification (lint, tests, builds), then summarizes and suggests next step.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you request a code change (e.g., 'implement this feature') or type `/code`. Claude switches to Developer persona.

say_en.text: Implement this feature following existing project patterns.
say_en.note: Claude will execute the process, switching to Developer persona if needed.

say_en.text: Write some code and run verification checks.
say_en.note: Claude will make minimal changes and run lint, tests, etc.

say_en.text: Implement this change without writing tests.
say_en.note: Claude will skip TDD and implement directly.
